text: APPROVE: the loop body moved into two helpers with identical logic (the `continue` became a `return` at the end of the loop body, and the `CHA0004` pragma still covers the catch), so behaviour is unchanged. `GatherLcov` is now a single loop, and the helpers are each well under 15.
